name: Gensou Jan Yuuki
source:
Yuichi loves girls and mahjong, but he's on his loosing spree for some time. While thinking that it's high time to retire from mahjong he suddenly appears in a place he never saw before. And new strange experiences await him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
雄一喜欢女孩和麻将，但他已经连续倒霉了一阵子。正当他觉得该退出麻将界时，他突然来到一个从未见过的地方。等待他的，是全新的奇妙经历。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
